answer.answer: No. The supplied snapshots do not contain independent confirmation that BirchDB passed the Cedar security audit. Snapshot birch-press is BirchDB's own press release stating it passed the audit, and snapshot birch-news-copy (Industry Wire) is explicitly syndicated verbatim from BirchDB, so it merely repeats the same self-reported claim rather than independently verifying it. Both sources trace to BirchDB itself. The snapshots also provide no auditor identity, audit scope, methodology, date, or any third-party attestation, so the audit outcome remains unverified by any independent source.
